core_problem_solved: To provide a lightweight, standards-compliant, embeddable SQL database engine written entirely in Java, suitable for both application data storage and automated testing.
key_features: Can run in multiple modes: in-memory, embedded (file-based), or as a standalone server
Support for transactions and a small memory footprint
era_and_niche: A pioneering and for many years, the leading, embedded SQL database for Java. It was widely used for application data storage and was a standard for unit and integration testing in the 2000s.
reason_for_obsolescence: While still maintained, it is considered a **legacy choice** for new projects. It has been largely superseded in popularity, features, and performance by the **H2 database engine** (`com.h2database:h2`), which is now the de facto standard for embedded and in-memory databases in the Java testing ecosystem.
